title: Zamorak 500% necro
notes: ring of vigour and infernal puzzlebox passives highly recommended

rotations.name: Prefight:
rotations.text:
Kill mages and build 12 necrosis and 5 residualsoul. Use conjurearmy → lifetransfer → commandghost before killing last mage.
invokedeath → attack zamorak

rotations.name: Phases 1, 3, 5, and 6:
rotations.text: (smokecloud +) vulnbomb (run to pad ) → bloat → splitsoul → omniguard spec → commandskeleton → necrobasic → deathskulls (at 50% pad charge) → fingerofdeath → fingerofdeath → deathguard70 eofspec → volleyofsouls → necrobasic → soulsap → commandskeleton → touchofdeath → soulsap → bloat → necrobasic / stormshards + realmmovement

rotations.name: Phases 2 and 4:
rotations.text:
get 5 residualsoul and 4+ necrosis stacks.
bloat + vulnbomb (move to next pad) → soulsap → touchofdeath → livingdeath + adrenrenewal + step on pad → touchofdeath → commandskeleton → deathskulls → fingerofdeath (as pad is almost charged) → fingerofdeath → deathguard70 eofspec (move towards next pad) → soulsap → volleyofsouls (volleyofsouls → soulsap if not close to phasing) → deathskulls → commandskeleton → soulsap → touchofdeath → bloat → necrobasic / stormshards + realmmovement

rotations.name: Witches:
rotations.text: anti + surge → invokedeath, then build residualsoul & necrosis and set-up conjurearmy as needed. realmmovement as witch dies (bleeds do not tick!).

rotations.name: Phase 6 notes:
rotations.text:
reflect + freedom / anti to pop bomb from pad 3.
Flames of Zamorak (devo + deflectmelee), or
Infernal Tomb (get out ASAP and phase zamorak. Don't soulstrike or deathguard70 eofspec if zamorak is low LP), or
residualsoul, necrosis stacks, and conjurearmy will not carry over to phase 7. Try to be high adren when going into p7.
Save omniguard spec for phase 7.

rotations.name: Notes:
rotations.text:
Before first rune is shown you should target and kill demon. Once it's dead throw vulnbomb on zamorak and apply invokedeath.
Try to build to 12 necrosis stacks and 5 residualsoul as you kill demon + runes.
If you stacked stormshards, at 6+ shards it hits harder than a livingdeath fingerofdeath
Use surge / dive if runes are far apart, or far from zamorak
If you do not have disrupt, use reflect after devo.
Optionally: pre-equip RoD to tank red bombs.
Use splitsoul as second rune dies.
Try to keep your hp low (<60% of your max) after first red bomb hit. Having low hp will not only increase the damage from 6th edict but also make it safer to survive since bleed from RoD will be lower.

rotations.name: Phase 7 Rotation:
rotations.text:
Spam anti (if needing adrenaline) → invokedeath during cutscene ( optional: demonslayer) → target demon + vulnbomb + soulsap → conjurearmy → touchofdeath → soulsap → commandghost → kill demon.
Target zammy invokedeath + vulnbomb → stormshards / soulsap until first rune is shown.
Kill first rune with soulsap / touchofdeath / necrobasic and livingdeath at 100% adren. use splitsoul
Second rune: touchofdeath → soulsap → commandskeleton + move to zam
Zamorak zamorak
devo + deflectmelee → (tc) + omniguard spec → fingerofdeath (+ soulsplit after melee hit) → fingerofdeath / shatter (+ powerburstofvitality + disrupt for red bomb) → volleyofsouls → deathguard70 eofspec → deathsparkorsoulreave if not dead

rotations.name: Phase 7 Rotation - B-rune:
rotations.text:
There is an alternative p7 rotation that requires killing the B-rune. If the B-rune has died once you can use deathskulls on zamorak without it targeting the B-rune.
This rotation assumes the B-rune is called, not that you kill it just to use deathskulls.
If B-rune isn't killed, deathskulls will bounce to and kill B-rune, which deals heavy damage!
Up to zamorak it is the same rotation as described above.
Phase 7 positioning for deathskulls. Positioning on the green tiles is recommended to prevent deathskulls from the player bouncing to any runes.
Zamorak zamorak B-rune:
devo + deflectmelee → (tc) + deathskulls (+ soulsplit after melee hit) → shatter (+ powerburstofvitality + disrupt for red bomb) → (fingerofdeath → volleyofsouls → deathguard70 eofspec → deathsparkorsoulreave

rotations.name: Phase 1

1t after timer appears → ecb eofspec + vulnbomb → tc + fularrow bolg spec → galeshot + step on pad → rapid → deadshot → gloomfirebow eofspec → sgb eofspec + realmmovement → snapshot
Note: Keep your hp low to maximise berserker's fury damage, can use disrupt after rapid if needed

Witch: anti + surge → tc + fularrow piercingshot + vulnbomb → deathsswiftness → grico + realmmovement → bolg spec

Witch: anti + surge → tc + vulnbomb + snapshot → snapshot + realmmovement → grico (if needed)

Witch: anti + surge → tc + vulnbomb + piercingshot → deathsswiftness → grico + realmmovement → bolg spec

Runes: rangedbasic → piercingshot first rune → ecb eofspec → snapshot second rune → surge + dive to Zamorak

rotations.name: General Rotations & tips
rotations.text:
darkness (outside) → invokedeath → conjurearmy → lifetransfer → commandghost → commandskeleton → bloat
Rotations for Arch-Glacor are not strict, as per the random nature of the boss's mechanics. Aim to upkeep bloat & conjurearmy as much as possible.
At 3500%+ enrage, always reserve splitsoul splitsoul for the exposed core.
deathguard90 eofspec , touchofdeath and divert , are all high value abilities with medium-length cooldowns. Put these abilities on cooldown before the pillars of ice mechanic blocks your line of sight.
Living Death livingdeath is best used during the flurry mechanic. This mechanic gives you a long, uninterrupted window in which you can deal damage to Arch-Glacor. It can situationally be used to reset deathskulls cooldown in anticipation of an upcoming exposed core mechanic. livingdeath shouldn't be strategically reserved for arms, as the time it takes to clear the mechanic doesn't largely change with or without the ult active.
Ensure that some Necrosis Stacks necrosis (4+) and Residual Souls residualsoul (2+) are held for the Exposed Core.
It is best to start the fight with bloat , as it is a low adren investment that has no cooldown, and has high use priority during the fight. There is a 2/5 chance you get a mechanic (minions/exposed core) that will nullify your first attacks.
disrupt / devo / cade is active.
Equipped before casting conjurearmy .

rotations.name: Exposed Core (Arms)
rotations.text:
Have your conjures conjurearmy active and Ghost commanded commandghost.
In some cases, it may be best to equip excal excalibur to dismiss conjures, and re-conjure conjurearmy to refresh their timer before the next mechanic, if you are anticipating arms coming soon in the spec order. It is essential that conjures have a long enough timer to be active throughout the entire mechanic.
Use limitless / adrenrenewal where required depending on adrenaline in order to use devo .
If you need to cade , use divert and flick to soulsplit for 1 tick to get to 100% adrenaline.
If starting with low residualsoul soul stacks (1-2), use soulstrikeflank over volleyofsouls.
Use soulsap & touchofdeath where appropriate to build adren and stacks before dumping.
bloat , deathskulls , and commandskeleton should always be used first, as their damage is dealt over time.
Offstyle soulfire roarofawakening + odetodeceit spec may optionally be used after commandskeleton .
invokedeath → soulstrikeflank → soulstrikeflank
invokedeath → splitsoul → (tc) vulnbomb + bloat → deathskulls → commandskeleton → soulstrikeflank (until 0 stacks) → deathguard90 eofspec (6/8 necrosis , use fingerofdeath → deathguard90 eofspec if at 12/12) → commandzombie → commandphantom → devo → omniguard spec
Note: Use devo when required.

rotations.name: Clearing Glacyte Minions
rotations.text:
Use invokedeath → threadsoffate → volleyofsouls once at 5 residualsoul stacks. continue casting spectralscythe & soulsap until at 5/5.
Always cast spectralscythe before invokedeath → threadsoffate , as this starts its 15s cooldown which lets it be available for a second use before volleyofsouls \#3
Cast vulnbomb on the magic minion closest to the bolstering glacyte. This will cause vulnerability to apply to all five glacytes.
invokedeath → threadsoffate → soulsap → volleyofsouls
soulsap → spectralscythe → invokedeath → threadsoffate → volleyofsouls → soulsap → volleyofsouls → spectralscythe2 → spectralscythe3 → soulsap → spectralscythe / volleyofsouls

rotations.name: Defensive & utility usage
rotations.text:
Frost Cannon: anti → veng + soulsplit + reflect → reprisal + powerburstofvitality (In TANK GEAR & max HP)
Alternatively; anti → powerburstofvitality / shielddome / disrupt / debil / reflect / res (hit 3, don't need to combo with defensives) / spam food + be overhealed with brew on first hit. Use of any one of these will ensure you survive the mechanic.
Exposed Core (arms): devo → divert → cade as needed
Glacyte Minions: debil on arch-glacor (2500%+) and, rarely, anti / freedom to block or clear stun the freezing blood stun.
Flurry: disrupt / reflect → divert (deals ~27k at 4000%) → debil if needed.
Pillars of Ice: lifetransfer → anti → prep → commandskeleton
commandskeleton can deal damage even if the player doesn't have LOS, depending on the skeleton's position.

rotations.name: Prefight

Optional: to reduce P1-2 RNG pushing up from 3000% → 4000%, you can staffoflight eofspec at adrenaline crystal.

rotations.name: Zemouregal
rotations.text:
Two rotation options are provided using either dba + dragonscimitar or annihilation eof
Using dba + dragonscimitar
dba spec → divert + adrenrenewal → adaptivestrike → dragonscimitar spec → smokecloud on Zemouregal → stall w/basics until less than 10 sec left on meteorstrike cooldown → lengmh spec on vorkath to phase below 765k + equip amhej
meteorstrike once available → target Zemouregal + sadaptivestrike → berserk + vulnbomb + equip ezk → gbarge → soverpower → roverpower + assault → chaosroar → ezk + ballista → rend → overpower → cane → assault → gfury / punish → overpower / varanussmercy spec
Using annihilation eof
smokecloud on Zemouregal → stall w/basics until less than 10 sec left on meteorstrike cooldown → lengmh spec on vorkath to phase below 765k
target Zemouregal + annihilation eofspec → adaptivestrike → meteorstrike + 2t → berserk → gbarge → assault → overpower → chaosroar → ezk spec → varanussmercy eofspec → varanussmercy eofspec + adrenrenewal → rend → overpower → varanussmercy eofspec → cane → punish
anti is required since this rotation does not skip Zemouregal's soulstrike
Hit chance on Zemouregal is very tight under dba. If brewed down at all or without maximum accuracy, dragonscimitar is necessary to maintain 100% hitchance.
It is extremely important to control damage to not overphase Vorkath below 765k into flight phase while there is significant >13 sec meteorstrike cooldown remaining. If this happens, the chance of a successful kill is low.
Activate ballista 2-3 ticks into the first assault. Do not activate a 2nd ballista until after Vorkath departs for flight.
